description: This file defines an API endpoint class 'AuthenticateEndpoint' for user authentication in a web application. It handles login requests by verifying user credentials via ASP.NET Core Identity's SignInManager and generating a JWT token upon successful login.

classes.name: AuthenticateEndpoint
classes.description: API endpoint for authenticating users, handling login requests, and issuing JWT tokens.

methods.name: HandleAsync
methods.description: Handles the incoming authentication request, verifies credentials, and returns an authentication response including JWT token if successful.
